reviews.text: It is always easy working with the front desk staff to have appointments scheduled even if I have to wait for them cause there is such a demand for appointments at the Bridge Clinic. They always treat my cats so well even when they are being stinky (they need premeds sometimes). I know my boy always is a handful any time he is in the clinic especially for their affordable diagnostics. My girl on the other hand is usually manageable and they always tell me how good she does when she’s there.
Love this clinic!  Well run and a true community vet clinic.  They have low cost fix appointments every week and scheduling is a breeze.

Craziest story ever- I brought my Persian cat to get neutered. They called me to ask for permission to shave off a few mattings he had in his fur. As I was aware of the matting, a couple of clumps on his lower back that I was actively dealing with- I approved. I came to pick him up and to my horror and shock I discovered they decided to shave his entire fur off!!!! Charged me 50$, never got my consent to do that. His beautiful super long lush fur!!!! Right before winter too!!!! In what world do you live where you think it’s ok to do something like that?!?! I’m never going back. It’s going to take him years to grow it back. I tried to reach out a few times to get some answers. So far they ignored all my msgs. The carelessness is beyond.

THE BEST CLINIC FOR YOUR FUR BABY! WE NEED THE BRIDGE CLINIC IN NY!

Words Cannot describe how Happy & Blessed I am to have been recommended to The Bridge Clinic in Philadelphia!
I was given an outrageous Quote of $8500 by an ER hospital in Staten Island for My Fur Baby Kobe. After crying my eyes out thinking I was going to lose my dog, the receptionist gave me a flyer to call The Bridge Clinic. I called, they answered, I sent my dog's X-Rays and was scheduled for surgery the next morning (9/23/26)!

The Staff & The Doctor were AMAZING!
WE NEED THIS CLINIC IN NY!
THEY SAVED KOBE'S LIFE! #FrenchBulldog
THE BRIDGE CLINIC PHILADELPHIA IS AFFORDABLE, EMPATHETIC & PROFESSIONAL!!
I'M FOREVER GRATEFUL 🙏🏾
SPREAD THE WORD!! #BRIDGECLINICPHILADELPHIA
I'll update later with Kobe's recovery pics ❤️

If I could give less than 1 star, I would! They were my dogs vet, they seen my sweet Bella in April 2026 and diagnosed her with breast cancer! Was told to bring her right in if things change, so things did change we knew she was getting sicker, so I called on 8/21/26 and was told they have no appointments available but they can put me in after Labor Day to be seen! I said that’s to far away, she needs to be seen now! They said sorry I can make you appointment after Labor Day!they don’t care about our fur babies ! Needless to say my sweet Bella died on 8/23/26
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review, Shannon!

Went to the bridge and the doctors were very good with my dogs had no issues did very good exams and were very gentle, passionate and nice, til Tuesday when I brought my little dog for gastro symptoms, vomiting, diarrhea with mucus and some red blood in stool, gurgling stomach, not eating, up all night every hour going diarrhea. A Dr. Marks saw her and told me she wasn't going to give her metro because she wanted to wait 2 more days even up to a week.  What VET sends you home with a sick dog and tells you no she is not going to prescribe the metro and I need to wait while my dog is suffering with gastro pain.  Well, called yesterday Wednesday and they said they would give to the pharmacy to fill and they would call me. NO CALL AND NO MEDS.  My I called again this morning telling me that it wasn't APPROVED BY DR. MARKS and that I have to wait.  So here I am with my dog getting worse.  Up last 2 nights every hour to 1 and a half cleaning up mucusy diarrhea with some red blood due to the irritation of going to many times and now this morning she will not eat tons of gas coming out before she poops, stretching, and laying around.   But, they want to now why I'm yelling on the phone upset because my dog got worse instead of telling me to talk and call the girls who answer the phone sweetie or honey. WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOUR STAFF I NEVER ONCE CURSED OR CALLED THEM NAMES.. YES I AM GO I NG TO YELL BECAUSE I A M UPSET AND WHAT DOCTOR SENDS A SICK DOG GOME WITHOUT MEDS AND LETS THEM GET WORSE.  I KNOW WHO A VET BY THE NAME OF DR. MARKS. DON'T WORRY I WILL NEVER EVER USE THE BRIDGE AGAIN.
If I could I would leave 0 stars.
I GUESS YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR. SAD

I had a cat spayed here and also required extra care due to a heart murmur and an umbilical hernia. The Bridge clinic did a fantastic job at a cost that didn’t place me in debt. This was a fantastic veterinarian experience! The ladies working the check in had many calls and people hitting them all at once and were super patient and friendly with everyone. Very rare in today’s customer service world! It was very appreciated! The veterinarian and staff are top notch!! I highly recommend!
Very affordable!! My itchy asthmatic cat is now acting like a normal cat.
Thank you, Elizabeth!
Great experience.   Dr Barenbaum took the time to go over all my concerns and answered all my questions
It’s a OK clinic but if you are one minute late, they will deny you service but if you are 10 minutes early, you’ll wait for an hour because someone’s in front of you…..

If I could give this place 10 stars I would.The staff was amazing from the receptionist to the doctor to the assistants. They are very friendly, responsive and knowledgeable. You can tell they love animals and would do what the can, to help your animals. Not to mention affordable. They saved me alot of $$$ and most importantly saved my best friend. I would 1000 % recommend this place to everyone. They are truly the diamonds in the rough. God bless all those people and animals in that building. I will be forever grateful for your professionalism, attentiveness, and efforts.you guy are amazing!!!! Me and Zoey Thank you!!!

I will never go anywhere else with my sweet cat from here on out! Each and every staff member was polite, understanding and compassionate. They provided a thorough examination in a quick and timely fashion! Each step of the way, they consulted me with their findings and action plan. The prices were also extremely reasonable in comparison to other facilities. During such a hectic time, it is crucial to have a team like this one on your side! Thank you so much Bridge Clinic!
I'm very happy with the services at this veterinary clinic. They took great care of my furry friend, and the price for his surgery was reasonable. Thank you!

Thank you so much Dr.Mills and The Bridge Clinic staff for taking such excellent care of my cat Isabelle.  Dr.Mills, it was a nightmare getting her into a crate for her appointment. It means so much to me that you were able to fix her cherry eye all in one visit. We are so thankful and grateful for all that you do and the compassion you have showed us.  The staff is just so sweet, all smiles, and a pleasure to work with.   Best vet experience ever.   You guys are the best!!!

My cat was very sick and had a foreign body in her stomach. I felt helpless because I couldn’t find a veterinarian who was able to help until I reached out to the Bridge Clinic. Danielle took the time to calm me down, answer my questions, and guide me through every step of the process during one of the most stressful times I’ve ever experienced. Thanks to the incredible team at the Bridge Clinic, my cat had the surgery she needed and is now recovering. I am beyond grateful for the kindness, compassion, and care they showed us. Thank you to Danielle and everyone at the Bridge Clinic for giving my cat a second chance. I will never forget everything you did for us. ❤️
High-quality, professional care at low prices. Thank you, Bridge Clinic! I recommend you to all pet parents!
Thank you for your review, Estela!
Thank you, Ellen!

The Bridge Clinic saved my dog. He ate a large baited fish hook and we knew we were in trouble. Our vet quoted us 6-8k which was not feasible for us. The Bridge Clinic removed the hook and he is on the mend for under $1800.

Great vet.  Care about the animals and have a great admin set up.  Pricing is much lower than previous vets we used for our dogs.

Dr Turchin is amazing
Great spot! Fair price and incredible vets!
It was great.
Absolutely loved my time with The Bridge Clinic. They took great care of my cat Hope and helped with my worries. Gonna bring back more of my cats for their spay surgery.

5 stars ⭐️ are not enough for the consistently wonderful and professional care my 4 pets receive here. From the moment you call in, (especially if you are lucky enough to get  Seana on the phone -she deserves her own 10 star review) to the end of visit phone call summary from the Vet- everything is so well done and your pet receives amazing care at affordable prices. The Bridge Clinic and Pawprint Village are  such a wonderful gift to animals and their families!   Highly recommend !!
Jess is wonderful very helpful and calmed me down I was very anxious about appointment but she talked me through everything.  she is amazing

What an absolutely Wonderful place. The staff is Amazing, friendly kind. I took my kittens today and they took care of them as if I was doing it myself. That’s love just on a personal note. They got their first shot. The picture is how they were when they got home.

They get all the stars in the world from me. They went out and beyond.I am really grateful that I came to them. The whole team was greatttttt but SHOT OUT to Max from the Philly location that handled my called and made it happened for me and my baby girl Star. She means the world to me. When I explained my problem, she told me they wer booked up so she put me on hold while she called the other location in bensalem and started setting my dog up for an emergency pyometra surgery right away, and SHOT OUT to my lady Jaime from the Bensaem location. She made me feel so comfortable, the concerns, doubts and questions I had she took her time and answered 1 by 1. The prices were amazing but the fact that they are non profit I salute 🫡 the whole team and im glad I came across them. Thank you for your review, Demi!

I finally found a clinic for my mom's dog that treat him with AMAZING care.  Everyone here is amazing and keep me up to date with everything that is going on.  Thank you all so much for making this and amazing experience for my family.

Amazing staff,  friendly.
Very professional with a smile

I took my baby girl (sage stidham) there today . She went in for surgery for a blockage in her intestine.  The staff and everyone there treated her like family i would most definitely recommend them for all your pet need . Very professional and helpful staff if I could give more that 5 🌟 I definitely would . Thank you bridge clinic for all your help and love .
Our dog was neutered and chipped.. It was a great experience from beginning to end .. The staff was great explained everything and were very kind .. Highly recommend them ..

I love the clinic and the staff and appreciate everything they do ! They neutered all of my pets and I have never had an issue. Everyone is healthy and the pricing is perfect . The only issue I had was that check in was a little hectic and they didn’t take people in order , so some people who showed up after me got checked in first which was frustrating because I had to get to work . So a smoother check in process would be nice . But, that’s a minor issue the important thing is that I trust them .

Very responsive and helpful! They got my dog in for a same day partial tail amputation after she de-gloved the tip. Great pricing with even better service. & Everyone I came in contact with made a point to tell me how much they enjoyed meeting my girl! (I can assure you Kepler loved them all too)

The Bridge Clinic is amazing!!! This was my first visit and I was so nervous taking my cat Stanley for dental surgery. They were incredible every step of the way… from the kindness and patience of the staff answering the phones, the professional and caring technicians that greet you outside and the awesome vets that give you such a thorough review of your cat’s diagnosis, treatment and recovery plan. He is doing so wonderful because of them and I can’t say thank you enough times. Oh, and it was also so inexpensive considering everything they did for him. This place is the best!!!
🌻🐈🦋

Took our family dog to be euthanized and the front desk staff to the doctors were beyond nice and helpful. They not only walked us through every step, they sat with us and helped our dog go as comfortably as possible. They also allowed us as much time as we needed to say our goodbyes and were very compassionate about the situation.
Reasonable spay & neuter without waiting months for an appointment. Staff is friendly and check in is stream lined and efficient.

I don't typically leave reviews, but the level of nonchalance and disrespect I experienced at The Bridge Clinic in Philadelphia needs to be noted. I called on behalf of my elderly mother, who had an appointment scheduled on a day when we had around 2 feet of snow. Most places were closed or closed early due to the weather.

When I spoke with the receptionist, I simply asked if they could make an exception and not hold my mother responsible for another deposit. To my surprise, she claimed to be the supervisor and said exceptions were only made for a lady who had to take her son to the doctor and someone involved in a car accident.

I expressed my confusion, pointing out that most people couldn't get around in such weather. Her response was dismissive, stating the conversation was no longer productive, and abruptly informed me that my mother could no longer be seen there before hanging up.

The lack of understanding and respect was astonishing. I expected more compassion and flexibility given the circumstances. This experience was truly disappointing.
Thanks, Jeffrey!

I recently had to have my cat euthanized.  Not only was the price about half of what my former vet would have charged, they were more compassionate than any other vet I've ever dealt with in the past. They have a wonderful team that allowed me the time I needed to say goodbye. Dr. Kelly asked if I wanted some of his fur. I said yes and she said she was going to take the fur from over his heart. A week or so after I received a hand written card with not only a paw print but also a print of his nose. I would highly recommend these vets and staff to anyone.

The greatest veterinarians, staffs, and assistants! Responded to all our concerns since my cat had an FIP before, took great care with anesthesia before her spay, was honest and reasonable with price, and friendly staffs! Thank you so much for everything. This clinic will be my kitty's clinic from now on☺️ her recovery was extremely fast thanks to your care
My puppy had to get neutered reasonable price

My cat was really shy and lethargic when I adopted her from a cat cafe a few months ago. They claimed she was fully vetted and healthy, just a little shy and kept to herself. When I took her to my usual vet, we discovered she had stomatitis(which I had never heard of before), which was causing her a lot of pain. That explained why she was hiding and sleeping most of the time.

My vet recommended a dental consultation and that’s when I reached out to the Bridge Clinic. They were amazing from the initial consultation through the day of her surgery. The drop-off and pick-up process was really easy and I really appreciated being able to bring her home the same day. Their pricing is also very reasonable which made a super stressful situation a lot more manageable.

It’s been almost 1.5 months since her surgery and she’s feeling amazing!! After having 15 painful teeth removed, she’s finally super social and playful.

Thanks so much to the incredibly kind staff who took such good care of her. I really appreciate everything you did for little Bean!
Thank you, Luz!
Thank you for your review, Shannon!
Thank you, Iryna!
Very happy with the service and prices

We brought our dog Lily in for heartworm treatment and had a wonderful experience! The entire team is fantastic, from the front desk to the veterinarians, everyone was incredibly attentive and loving with our Lily during such a scary time for us. I would recommend them again and again if needed. The cost is affordable and the staff is a 10/10!
I loooove this place.  Everything is just so well thought out and the staff has always been capable, friendly, professional. I tell everyone to go here.
kind dr good help.  just changed my vet from one visit

The Bridge Clinic Philadelphia office were the first vet to notice my 3-month old French Bulldog Jake had abnormal narrow nostrils, possible bad patella & some sort of digestive disorder. For an inexpensive non-profit veterinary clinic, based on prior experience @ the Bensalem location, decided wanted to move to either of their locations as IMO, they're perhaps more qualified than other vets I've used w/ prior Frenchies.
Thank you, Natalie!

The Bridge Clinic team is absolutely fantastic, friendly, and kind. They cared for my Blue and kept me in the loop.
Thank you guys for all you do every day.

I visited the Bridge Clinic a couple of days ago and it was a great experience. I was there for a while, trying to handle assisting a vet bill for a client of theirs. In the time that I was there, I was treated with great respect and noticed how hard they were working. There were three women in the lobby that were constantly answering phones and providing great assistance for people. Some of them weren’t even able to cover their bills, and they were looking for resources to assist with Is something that I love to see and all the reason that I would strongly recommend this clinic to anyone.
What else can I say except I wish I could give them 10 stars for their professionalism, courtesy and overall excellent experience they provided in caring for four of my feline friends.
Amazing ! These ladies saved our boys life and we are so beyond grateful!

Had to bring my cat in for a consultation that led to dental surgery and the staff made me feel like she was in good hands! All went well and I paid a very reasonable price compared to what our regular vet quoted. Thank you so much! Highly recommend.

The bridge clinic provided a very cost effective alternative to my local vet when it came to a dental for my senior beagle. The “stay in your car” drop off and pick up are a little different experience but worth it to be able to afford the care that she needed. The staff were friendly and the paperwork and payment systems efficient. Thank you very much.

Took our 6 year old st Bernard in for a intestinal blockage surgery.  Dropped her off in the morning picked her up in the afternoon.  Pricing was great we were glad to be able to find this place it was a quick and easy process they answered all of our questions and made sure we had all the knowledge for after care.  Would recommend anyone who's dog needs a low cost operation or medical attention

I recently brought my dog to The Bridge Clinic for a foreign body removal, and I can’t say enough about how incredible the entire staff was. From the moment my husband dropped him off everyone was so communicative, reassuring, and genuinely compassionate. I was sick to my stomach with worry, but they treated my dog Maverick with such care and treated me with so much kindness that I instantly felt more at ease.

The team kept me informed every step of the way and made an extremely stressful situation so much more manageable. My dog received exceptional care, and I am beyond grateful for the professionalism and warmth shown throughout the entire process.

I would recommend this center to any dog lover. They truly go above and beyond
Super friendly and professional. Everything went well with spay on my cat.
Amazing staff with quick responses to appointment requests,  my cat had a full mouth extraction and the nurses were so sweet in calming my nerves !
Incredible staff that is genuinely empathetic and helpful. My cat had dental surgery and they made me feel calm a throughout the whole process. Their prices are reasonable!
Love them especially Dr Kelly

I help maintain a colony of feral cats in NJ and one of my boys is FIV+ and was having very painful tooth problems. The Bridge Clinic reviewed the case and was able to quickly schedule a surgery to extract his poor, damaged, loose or resorbed teeth. It's in a beautiful location and everyone I spoke with was very nice and I felt that my feral buddy was loved when he was there. It is very well run which is impressive when you consider how many people and pets they see every single day! Highly recommend!
Love this place! Always take great care of my dog! Thank you!!
Can't recommend The Bridge Clinic in Philadelphia enough, they did an amazing job of showing me and my dog compassion and calming both our nerves, super kind staff.
This place is wonderful!  They were willing to do surgery on a feral cat who was suffering when no one else would.  Now she has completely recovered and is living her best life.  Thank you!
i always know my cats are in such great hands here. the prices are incredible and the staff is so attentive, knowledgeable, and kind!

Great place to bring your pet for emergency or other services
Prices are 1/16 of other hospitals and was even better.

I used The Bridge Clinic in Bensalem 2 years ago when getting my pug spayed. They are reasonably priced, willing to work with pugs and knowledgeable.
A few weeks back I found out my fur baby had 5 bladder stones and 2 weeks before her situation would become life threatening. Once again I reached out to The Bridge. My funds are limited but my love for my pug is endless. I knew The Bridge Clinic would have a price more within my range. The Bridge went above and beyond to help assist us. They worked with our vet and vet hospital with getting the medical records quickly, they never made me feel I was bothering them and I called almost everyday within this 2 weeks. They helped point me in right direction of programs that might be willing to help assist with some funding towards surgery. Not many are willing to work in pugs given their flat faces but they always welcome Shady with hugs. Again, their pricing is amazing and I know my pug is getting top notch care. I understand vets need to get paid but it’s great knowing there is a clinic that understands not all pet owners have unlimited funds for surprise surgeries. I would and do trust The Bridge Clinic with my besties life, they saved it and I am forever grateful. THANK YOU!!!
Thank you, Nicole!

I could not be more satisfied!! I traveled across the bridge from NJ. Dr Kelly is amazing and so is the staff at this facility. I wish I had found them sooner. Everyone was so sweet and welcoming. My dog was comfortable the entire time and they handled her with such great care. They really are there for you and want to help!
Thank you, Pete!
Seamless experience. Ver is helpful. You can’t go inside though. Wish you could.

This place is a complete joke. If I could give zero stars, I would. I booked my appointment a week in advance and waited patiently for it, only to be treated with complete disregard and unprofessionalism. On the day of the appointment, we were just 10 minutes away, delayed by rush hour traffic. Out of courtesy, we called ahead to inform them—and instead of working with us, we were put on hold and then told they simply wouldn’t see us.

No grace period was ever mentioned when I booked the appointment. We were then told their appointments are only 20 minutes long, and the reason for refusing us was that the vet had to leave early to pick up her kids at 4:30—even though the clinic is listed as open until 5:00 PM. So which is it—poor scheduling, or just complete disregard for clients' time?

When we rightfully expressed our frustration after being dismissed, the woman on the phone became rude and condescending, saying, “I don’t know why you don’t understand,” and eventually snapped with, “This conversation is no longer productive.” She even went so far as to threaten us not to come and then hung up the phone.

This level of disrespect is completely unacceptable. Unprofessional, disorganized, and downright rude. I will never return, and I strongly advise anyone who values their time, money, and dignity to look elsewhere.

Cannot say enough great things about the Bridge Clinic from their caring Vet Techs to their Phenomenal Vets. I was facing surgery for my dog and quoted prices that were simply impossible. The Bridge Clinic did the surgery at a fraction of what I was being quoted and did it with such expertise and care. You all deserve 10 stars !

Best Veterinary Services in the city of Philadelphia. It’s affordable, they will never turn you away. Dr. Gabriel Mills is one of the Finest Veterinarian Doctors I have met in many years. He is a humble man kind and loyal to his profession. His staff, are courteous, kind, and respectful team, and  always there for you. I can’t forget the beautiful technicians behind the scenes they are very gentle when handling our pets. I want to personally thank Mia the technician for her kindness on Tuesday, helping me with my pet Queenie.

Five Stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We can’t thank the Philadelphia Bridge Clinic enough for the incredible care and compassion they showed our sweet “Bo the Corner Store Kitty” we rescued. From day one, they went above and beyond to help us through a journey that included FHO surgery, neutering, flea treatment, deworming, and multiple follow-up visits.
Every step of the way, the team treated Bo like one of their own pets. Their dedication, kind-heartedness, and professionalism made a world of difference…not just for Bo, but for my wife and me as well. They even helped connect us with donors to ease the financial burden of his care. That kind of support is rare and deeply appreciated. The Philly Bridge Clinic team even came up with his name (and we love it!!!).
We are so grateful to the Bridge Clinic staff and their extended network for making Bo’s recovery possible. If you’re a pet owner in Philly, make this your first stop for veterinary care. They genuinely care about your furry family members, and it shows.
Their facility is clean, well-spaced for cats and dogs, and has a friendly atmosphere. They leverage technology to keep records and communication running smooth but never lose their human touch in the process. A true gem in the domain of pet care!
This place is a FULL-SERVICE, NONPROFIT VETERINARY CARE operation. Their heart and soul is in everything they do for pets that come through their doors. No task is too big or small. The techs, staff and doctors talk “WITH” you and not “AT” you. Visits to their office are refreshening.
Highly, highly recommended.
Fareed & Family 🐾
called and got an appointment a week later! great prices, and the staff was so friendly… thank you for taking such great care of Lily (included a pic of her relaxing at home the night after her spay)

Remarkable Veterinary services!. Dr. Kelly and her  staff were extremely caring professionals. Received Vaccines and health Check for my ESA dog. Im a Disabled   US Veteran and I cannot thank you enough for treating Luna! THANK YOU!
The Bridge Clinic has great staff and affordable prices. Loved the expedited manner of services.
Friendly staff, well organized and reasonable fees for my pets.  They also have a good spay/neuter system in place.  I highly recommend this vet clinic.

I can never thank dr mills and the staff at the bridge clinic enough. They saved my cats life! Urinary blockage. So great with communication and conscientious of my limited budget. So thoughtful and loving towards my baby. My forever gratefulness is immeasurable. Highly recommend

Had a great experience at the Bridge Clinic. Cannot recommend them enough, they were very quick to respond to my online inquiry to get my boy scheduled and within a very reasonable time frame. They offer sedated exams, which my very anxious dog needed to get his nails trimmed. Other places were offering to bring us in for a consult and asking for me to bring him back, which not only causes anxiety for my dog but also for me because he doesn’t like majority of other dogs. I even left with anxiety medication for future visits instead of having to sedate him each time. Everyone I encountered was very helpful kind and pleasant

Stray Kitty Rescue uses and loves the bridge clinic- just show up to your appointments on time and keep open and honest communications with them!!!
This place is amazing! Super friendly staff, great vets and very reasonable!!!
Took my cat here for dental extractions and it went great. Definitely recommend this place, especially for surgery.

There aren't enough words to begin to convey our gratitude toward the bridge clinic Philadelphia
To say they saved my cat is an understatement especially since they were able to do it without breaking my bank
The ER tried charging us 10 times what we paid here
We got much better care here than either of the vets we tried before coming across this one
The staff was professional and knowledgeable
Very smooth process
I would highly recommend this place over the commonplace ER or animal hospital
Thank you for your feedback, Liz!

I do not even know where to begin!  My baby boy was critical and in need of surgery asap. He had an obstruction in his intestines and was very sick. Everyone at the clinic worked above and beyond to help save his life and mine. If you even can question where you should go for vet services you need to look no further. They are the best!
Thank you for your review Liana!
The people here couldn’t be any nicer. The pricing was such a blessing and they took care of my pup! I highly recommend.
Thank you for your review!
We appreciate the feedback, Andrew!

I wish i could of found this place Sooner! The Doctors were Very kind and treated my animals well and  they definitely know what thier doing!  The expenses were alot cheaper then my regular vet. I would recommend this  place for anyone who Needs a Good Vet! 😸🐾 …
Lovely staff, amazing service! Highly recommend bringing your fur babies to see everyone at the bridge clinic in Philadelphia!
Thank you, Bianca!

Took my small Chihuahua dog here for his wellness checkup and tracheal condition!! He really got the best care from Dr. Mills and team here they are very nice and welcoming very satisfied!!! They truly care about the animals here and will be back!!! Great job!!!
Thank you, Shilpa!
very helpful.
Excelent personal, great attention 👌🏼✅ …

My beloved dog Bo had an ultra sound which found a foreign object in his stomach.  I took him to Bridge clinic in Philadelphia for emergency surgery. Unfortunately, during the surgery, it was found that he also had cancer throughout his body. I can't give
enough praise about their staff Danielle,  Rose and Dr. Heck! Their kindness, caring and emotional support were overwhelming! Dr. Heck and Danielle are perfect in the positions they are in. They were so supportive in all areas!  If I ever get another pet this is the only Veterinarian and clinic I will take them to! They are absolutely the best. Thank you Danielle, Dr. Heck, Rose, and all the staff at Bridge Clinic!

Our family cannot thank the staff and doctors at The Bridge Clinic enough. Our golden retriever, Ellie, was taken to our local vet because she had started drinking a lot of water and seemed less active in the days leading up to her visit.

Although she was still eating, playing, and moving about we thought she may be getting sick. We had NO idea how sick she was! Upon eval at our local vet we were advised to get Ellie to an emergency vet that evening due to the diagnosis of Pyometra.

We drove immediately to a nearby emergency animal hospital where we were quoted between $8,000-$10,000 for emergency surgery, plus the $1,400 already spent for the ultrasound and walk-in visit cost. We did not have this type of funds readily available for the surgery and were heartbroken to think about what the next steps might be.

Due to the nature of Ellie’s condition, and without many alternatives we were given the name of The Bridge Clinic. The wonderful woman on the other end of the call that Friday evening got the wheels in motion and we were set up for our sweet Ellie to have surgery first thing that Monday morning.

Despite some computer glitches and delayed oxygen delivery that Monday, the staff and doctors made sure to get Ellie in and provided both pre and post surgical work that led to our baby girl coming home to our family. Something we weren’t sure was going to happen had we not found The Bridge Clinic.

Lessons were learned throughout this entire ordeal, and we will be taking our other sweet canine to The Bridge Clinic in the following weeks to have her spayed. I truly didn’t realize the importance and impact of having our girls spayed, until this happened.

Spay and Neuter, and use The Bridge Clinic.

The Bridge Clinic needs and deserves donations to continue providing this high-level of care at an affordable cost.

Thank you again, Bridge Clinic

Love,
Ellie’s family
